description: M11A loading screen tips — 60 entries. Random selection per scenario load. Authored from M25A narrative bible. Voice: gritty + tactical + slightly noir. Each tip teaches something useful OR conveys atmosphere.

tips.text: A jammed weapon clears in three seconds. The second jam clears slower. By the fourth, the round is fused to the chamber and you are out of luck.
On Europa, your air lasts four minutes longer if you keep your helmet sealed below 270 Kelvin. Frost slows the recycler; it does not stop it.
Suppress before you advance. A Coalition squad that holds the trigger down for two seconds wins more firefights than one that aims for three.
Concrete sets in nine minutes. Steel sets in nine seconds. Spalling does not wait either way.
Tourniquet first. Bandage second. A casualty who is bleeding out does not care which limb you treated in what order, only how fast.
Coalition pays on delivery. Frontier pays on completion. Ronin pays on the third moon after the contract closes, and never in cash.
Phoebe Chillax will not let a single hit ruin your evening. Randy Random will let three asteroid impacts ruin your decade. Pick the chair you can sit in.
The third elevator on Lagrange-7 has a button labeled BANK. There is no bank. There is, however, a room.
The Command Core was not invented. It was excavated. Mars, 2147. The hole it came out of is still down there, and the readings are still going up.
Caption density is a setting, not a punishment. Turn it down if the screen is full. Turn it up if you keep dying to things you did not see coming.
Drop-in coop divides loot by contribution, not by who picked it up. The one carrying ammo to the line is the one earning the artifact.
Crouch reduces your silhouette by forty percent. Prone reduces it by seventy. Dead reduces it to zero, but nobody recommends that one.
Vacuum exposure kills humans in twenty-two seconds. Methane breathers find it refreshing. Choose your gear by who is wearing it.
A jet pack is a tool for crossing terrain, not for crossing minds. If you think you can outrun a Synth predictor swarm, you have not met one.
Cardiac shock has a ninety-second window. CPR buys thirty. Epinephrine buys sixty. After that, you are paying respects, not bills.
The Husks remember every face that took something from them. They do not write it down. They wear it.
Ironman does not save. Ironman does not reload. Ironman shipped one save file with your name on it and you signed for it at the start of the run.
The Lagrange Concordat was signed in 2087 by seventeen heads of state. Twelve of them were dead within a decade. Eleven from related causes.
A shotgun at four meters is a sidearm. At eight meters it is a noise. At sixteen meters it is a confession.
Cold drains battery twice as fast as heat. Heat drains coolant twice as fast as cold. Pick your poison; the math does not care.
A landing pad is a strategic asset. A landing pad with a fuel depot next to it is a strategic asset and a target. Build accordingly.
Limb loss is not death. Limb loss with no medic on station within ninety seconds usually is.
The Starlight Concordant does not seek combat. They will simply call down something larger than you, then read the survey notes over your remains.
Cassandra Classic believes in earned victories. She also believes in earned losses. She is consistent about both.
Project Lagrange awakened in 2147. The Synth Collective traces its founding to the third minute it was conscious. The first two minutes are classified.
If you stand still in a Crystalfold settlement long enough, the locals begin to sing. They are not singing for you. They are singing about you.
Stance matters. A standing aim adds one percent recoil per shot. Crouch halves that. Prone bracing on a wall caps it. Know your tier.
Anomalies do not move. They do, however, expand. The distance to safety changes; the location of the kill zone does not.
A repair foam pack will close a 4 cm breach in eight seconds. A 16 cm breach in eighteen seconds. A 64 cm breach in the time it takes to die.
Insanity is treatable. Berserker mode is treatable. Both at once requires a friend, a sedative, and the willingness to be wrong about which goes first.
Collegium scientists do not pay for samples. They pay for sample chains. Three intact organs from the same anomaly, and they will let you walk.
Randy Random does not hate you. Randy Random does not love you. Randy Random thinks you are interesting in the way a campfire is interesting to a child.
Olympus Mons was claimed in 2168 by the Mars Free State. It was declaimed in 2169. The Frontier still flies the Free State colors at funerals.
Camera shake can be disabled from the Comfort tab. Vehicle telemetry will still display. The game will still play. Your stomach will thank you.
Reload while moving. Reload behind cover. Reload while the enemy is reloading. Do not, under any circumstances, reload in the doorway.
The Mimas methane sea is breathable to some, lethal to most. If your origin is not on the brochure, it is on the menu.
A breach charge applied to concrete makes a door. Applied to steel, it makes a noise. Applied to alloy, it makes a request the wall politely declines.
Blood type matters even after Earth. Synth-blood compatibility, less so, since the manufacturer specifies your match on the back of the pouch.
The Ronin do not collect debts. They carry them. When they put a debt down, the person who owed it is also down, and rarely getting back up.
Sandbox does not narrate. Sandbox observes. The events you face are the events you spawned. The math is not personal.
The Hollow King has been killed seventeen times. The seventeenth survivor died fourteen months later, alone, of cardiac shock. The Coalition closed the casket.
Voice of Many speaks with the voices of one hundred and forty-three Crystalfold. Voice of Many does not speak quietly.
Melee is a tool. Melee is not a strategy. The Ronin think otherwise. The cemetery in Three Cuts disagrees with them.
Radiation accumulates. Bandages do not undo it. The only treatment is distance, time, and a chelation drip your liver will remember.
A solar array on Venus produces six percent rated output. A solar array on Mimas produces zero. A solar array on the Sol Zone produces sixteen times rated output and then melts.
Auto-triage triggers at three bleed stacks or two poison stacks or thirty percent HP and one limb loss. Medics know this. So do the things hunting medics.
Synth nodes do not retreat. Synth nodes redistribute. The same drone you killed last tour may report for duty next tour, with the same paint scratches.
Cassandra Classic will let you win three battles in a row before turning the screw. Phoebe Chillax will let you win five. Ironman lets you win exactly once.
First Contact was in 2087. Or 2034. Or 1968. The Collegium archives three accounts; the Husks remember a fourth; the Synth nodes claim no record exists.
Friendly fire is on by default. If you cannot tell which silhouette is your squadmate, neither can the turret behind you.
Aim for the head if you are a sniper. Aim for the center mass if you are a rifleman. Aim for the knees if you are out of ammo and need to negotiate.
Hunger kills slowly. Thirst kills faster. Exhaustion kills first, because you stopped paying attention to the things that kill quickly.
A drone deployer at full charge launches four units. Three return. Two return functional. Plan your overwatch with this in mind.
Smelling salts cost twelve credits and clear concussion in four seconds. A medic visit clears it in nine seconds and costs nothing. Triage your wallet too.
The Coalition will fortify a position for three days. The Frontier will hold one for thirty minutes. Both will tell you they won, and from their angle they did.
Ironman runs see one solar flare per six in-game days. Cassandra runs see one per nine. The difference is whether the flare arrives the night you forgot to charge the backup batteries.
The Belt was emptied of pirate cells in 2179. It was refilled by 2181. Nature, even out here, abhors a vacuum.
The Persistent Gun Oil vial is labeled in four languages. The fourth is not Earth-standard. The Collegium will pay handsomely for the bottle.
Reload speed beats fire rate beats damage. A rifle that empties three magazines a minute outscores a rifle that empties one and a half, every time.
The base does not save you. The base lets you save yourself. If your fortifications are doing the work, you are already losing. Make them buy you time, not victory.
